component.name: ConfTune FC
component.summary: System setup, configuration and performance tuner for Fedora, Rocky Linux, and CentOS

description.p: ConfTune FC is a safety-first configuration, setup, and performance tuning application built specifically for RPM-based Linux distributions, including Fedora Workstation & Server, Rocky Linux, CentOS Stream, AlmaLinux, and RHEL.

Featuring both a modern GNOME Adwaita Dark interface and a headless CLI for remote server administration, ConfTune FC optimizes kernel sysctl parameters, DNF package concurrency, storage TRIM maintenance, CPU power scaling, systemd-oomd memory pressure, and specialized workloads including Docker/Podman, KVM virtualization, and Virtualmin web hosting.

ul.li: Automatic pre-tune snapshots with instant 1-click rollback
Workload presets: Workstation, Gaming low-latency, Server, Database, and Web
Two-tier privilege separation with native PolicyKit (pkexec) elevation
DNF4 and DNF5 multi-threaded download acceleration and mirror optimization
Portable configuration bundles, standalone deploy scripts, and Ansible Playbooks

description.p: Security hardening and metadata privacy maintenance release:

ul.li: Anonymized RPM spec file changelog records and removed personal email addresses
Hardened repository .gitignore with comprehensive secret, private key, and credential exclusion patterns

description.p: Autostart Manager live status indicators and coredump rollback release:

ul.li: Added live status badge and dynamic toggle button for ABRT bug reporting daemons in the Autostart Manager
Added Default (Undo) rollback button and live storage ceiling status indicator for systemd-coredump
Synchronized coredump storage limit selector on tab load with active drop-in configuration
Grayed out root-only coredump ceiling controls and ABRT daemon management when running as an unprivileged user

description.p: Table cell layout, button alignment, and visual polish release:

ul.li: Centered and aligned action and reset buttons across the Kernel Sysctl, Boot & Systemd, and Autostart tables
Embedded table cell buttons inside centered QHBoxLayout containers with fixed column geometry
Fixed CSS min-width constraints in QTableWidget preventing button overflow

description.p: User-mode safety, granular default/undo rollback, and desktop refinement release:

ul.li: Automatically gray out all root-only options and controls when running as an unprivileged user
Added dedicated Default / Undo actions across all modules for granular 1-click rollback
Added live active state indicators (green/gray/red) for custom overrides vs stock defaults
Corrected GNOME window header button order to minimize, maximize, close matching GNOME Tweaks
Fixed live DNF parallel downloads detection and checkbox loading state across DNF4/DNF5
Optimized layout spacing in Tuning Profiles tab to eliminate whitespace and maximize visible area

description.p: Beta release notices and alignment with ConfClean FC:

ul.li: Added beta software caution disclaimers, liability terms, and backup guidance
Added amber BETA pill indicator to GUI top header bar
Added safety notice card to the System Dashboard & Overview view
Fixed label and typography background blending across cards, header bar, and dialogs by enforcing transparent widget backgrounds

description.p: Privilege escalation and GUI presentation release:

ul.li: Integrated proven PolicyKit elevation with asynchronous handshake and XWayland authorization
Fixed action button dimensions and text truncation in Boot and Systemd optimizer
Refined Adwaita Dark styling and status pill badges

description.p: Initial universal production release of ConfTune FC for Fedora, Rocky Linux, and CentOS:

ul.li: 16 specialized GUI views with GNOME 45+ Adwaita Dark styling
Two-tier privilege boundary locking administrative write operations
Ansible Playbook and standalone shell script generators
Dual-path DNF4 and DNF5 acceleration
Full unit test coverage with 112 passing tests
